His hunt for Obi-Wan ends in death on Tatooine.

affiliation: Cloud-Riders (leader)
summary: From a family of fighting women, Enfys takes her mother's mask and leads the Cloud-Riders at sixteen, hiding her age behind armor. Branded a marauder, she harries Crimson Dawn and clashes with Tobias Beckett's crew over coaxium on Vandor and Savareen, then reveals her rebel cause, wins Han Solo's help, and gives the fuel to Saw Gerrera.

affiliation: White Worms → Crimson Dawn (under Dryden Vos, then Maul) → Crimson Dawn (leader)
summary: Han Solo's first love, Qi'ra is left behind on Corellia when he escapes and claws her way up Crimson Dawn under Dryden Vos. In 10 BBY she kills Vos to save Han, then takes his place as Maul's lieutenant. Later leading Crimson Dawn herself, she schemes to topple the Sith, fails when the Knights of Ren free them, and disappears.

name: Galen Erso
affiliation: Galactic Republic (Futures Program) → Galactic Empire (Tarkin Initiative) → Alliance to Restore the Republic (secretly)
summary: A crystallographer from Grange, Galen studies kyber until his friend Krennic turns his work into a weapon. He flees with his family to Lah'mu, but Krennic tracks them down, has his wife Lyra killed, and forces him back to the Death Star. Galen plants a flaw in the station, warns the rebels, and dies on Eadu in Jyn's arms.

name: Bail Organa
affiliation: Galactic Republic (Senate) → Galactic Empire (Imperial Senate) → Alliance to Restore the Republic
summary: Senator for Alderaan and consort to its queen, Bail champions peace and democratic reform through the Clone Wars and stands by the Jedi. When the Republic falls he hides Yoda and Obi-Wan, adopts Anakin and Padmé's daughter Leia, and spends two decades building a rebellion with Mon Mothma and Ahsoka Tano. He dies with Alderaan when the Death Star fires.

summary: A pacifist who leads the New Mandalorians through their civil war, guarded by a young Obi-Wan Kenobi, Satine rules Mandalore as duchess and rebuilds it as a peaceful state. In the Clone Wars she defends its neutrality against Republic pressure and Death Watch, which counts her sister among its ranks. When Maul seizes Mandalore, he kills her before Obi-Wan's eyes.

His pact with the Separatists fails and drives Death Watch into exile. Allied with Maul, he takes Mandalore in a staged rescue and rules briefly, until Maul kills him in a duel for the throne.
